fact_updates.rationale: Two supply_low events name the same item (size 2 diapers) and the same reorder quantity (128), with days since last order of 14 and 15. Both resulting place_supply_order actions were approved. Rate is derived only by dividing the quantity by those day gaps.

pattern_detections.pattern: Size 2 diapers reordered at 128 units roughly every 14-15 days
